ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of the Righteous Brothers: 20th Century Masters Millennium Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic melodic vocals appeal to me, but I would choose an orchestral vocal album first today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis: Ultimate Gospel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for relaxing classical or crossover vocals rather than a gospel collection right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The vocal duets fit my interest in polished performances like A Musical Affair and Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: Someday at Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Christmas listening history does not mean I want seasonal music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: American Folk Anthology / Various; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad folk anthology is less aligned with my current interest in orchestral music and expressive vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Andrea Bocelli Si CD; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Bocelli's classical crossover vocals closely match my interest in Amor & Pasion and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: Let It Snow; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not seeking a holiday album right now, and the title alone gives me little other reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title is appealing, but without the artist I cannot tell whether these performances fit my taste closely enough.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary soulful pop is less suited to my current mood than classical crossover or relaxing instrumental music.
ItemID: NA; Title: All That Echoes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed the direction of Stages, so another Josh Groban album feels like a strong choice for expressive vocals.
